area: Arcade controllers, ResourceSystem, AI training docs
summary: Salvaged from Garrett's stale October branches (cece/exciting-thompson-wdi3wm, cece/nice-brahmagupta-ojclij part K) onto today's bleeding-edge: (1) four fire-and-forget delays in SkimRaceController, NetworkScoreTracker and MultiplayerMiniGameControllerBase are bound to destroyCancellationToken; (2) BaseScoreTracker.OnDestroy unsubscribes every scorer, so a tracker destroyed without a turn end stops adding time score from the menu; (3) ResourceSystem.Reset returns when Resources is null (Unity's edit-mode Reset message); (4) the skim-steering rules added to Utility/AITraining/README.md and two Sparrow L5 rows fixed in FLEET_MAPS.md. Reference compile 0 errors in changed files; not run in Unity (checklist entries added).
